response: {"title":"Final requirement sweep","intervention":"Before declaring the task complete, reread the original request once and check each explicit requirement against the final diff across all touched Python modules, fixing any uncovered item within the remaining deadline.","claim":"Compared with no appended instruction, this single final sweep will raise the proportion of fixed-deadline multi-module Python tasks satisfying every explicit requirement while adding at most 10% to median wall time and turns.","mechanism":"A forced comparison between the stable source request and the concrete final diff counters attention decay and premature stopping that leave late or cross-module requirements unimplemented.","assumptions":["The original request remains available at completion time.","Enough deadline remains for one concise reread and targeted correction."],"risks":["The sweep may occur too late to repair a substantial omission.","Diff-only checking can miss required behavior caused by untouched modules or runtime configuration.","Rereading may prompt unnecessary scope expansion from ambiguous wording."],"test_plan":{"experiment":"Randomize matched dispersed-requirement Python tasks between this appended instruction and no appended instruction under identical agent and deadline settings.","metrics":["pass_rate","wall_time","turns"],"success_condition":"The instruction arm achieves a higher all-requirements pass_rate and neither median wall_time nor median turns exceeds control by more than 10%."},"single_shot_ordinal":2}
